title: Why AI keeps drawing extra fingers

beats.say: In one viral AI party photo, a guest held a camera with eight fingers.
Five is normal. Eight is the algorithm.
Why? Stability AI says hands are usually small in the training photos. Faces get the close-ups.
And hands are almost always holding something, so the AI only sees pieces of them.
A computer scientist in London put it simply. These models have no concept of a hand in three dimensions.
It just blends finger shaped patterns. And keeps going.
